Questions, answered

Is cash on delivery available?+

Yes — cash on delivery is available all over Pakistan. You pay the rider when your parcel arrives.

How do I place an order?+

Add sets to your bag and tap "Order on WhatsApp", or message us directly with the design name and your size. We confirm everything before dispatch.

What if the colour looks different in person?+

Screen colours can vary slightly. Message us on WhatsApp and we will send you a daylight photo of the exact set before you order.

Can I exchange a set?+

Yes — unused sets in original condition can be exchanged within 7 days of delivery.

How long does delivery take?+

Orders are dispatched quickly and usually arrive within 2–4 working days, depending on your city.
